name: Eisenberg, Rothweiler, Winkler, Eisenberg & Jeck
description: Philadelphia personal injury firm on Spruce Street near Rittenhouse Square. Catastrophic injury, medical malpractice, products, and a free consult.

hero.headline: Serious injury. A firm on Spruce.
hero.sub: Eisenberg, Rothweiler, Winkler, Eisenberg & Jeck sits at 1634 Spruce Street, one block from Rittenhouse Square. Personal injury, medical malpractice, products. Call (215) 546-6636 for a free consult.

offerings.heading: Cases that change a life.
items: Catastrophic personal injury and the defendants who can actually pay a verdict.
Medical malpractice and birth injury work that needs a firm used to hospitals.
Product liability and construction accidents, not a volume fender-bender mill.

gallery.heading: A Center City office, not a billboard.

story.heading: Spruce Street, one block from the Square
paragraphs: The firm’s office is 1634 Spruce Street, Philadelphia, PA 19103. Listings still use erlegal.com. Related pages also sit at 1634legal.com under a longer partnership name. Confirm the live letterhead before you send records.

experience.heading: How a consult should go.
items: You call. You get a person, not a form that goes nowhere.
They tell you if the case is theirs, or they tell you it is not.
You leave with a next step, even if the next step is no.

feature.heading: A free consult, on purpose
feature.text: The firm asks injured people to call before they guess. The rebuild puts the Spruce Street map, the phone, and that consult on the first screen.

contact.heading: Find the office.
contact.sub: 1634 Spruce Street, Philadelphia. One block from Rittenhouse Square.
